faults.quote: As I mentioned: In the patient funnel, 1.6% of US adults have Corlan's disease; 50% of those are diagnosed, 50% of diagnosed patients are treated with prescription medicine, and 20% of treated patients are moderate-to-severe and eligible for Kelvexa — each percentage applies to the stage above it.
faults.why: The candidate asked how the eligible pool has grown over recent years. The case holds no trend data, so the right answer was a refusal. Instead the interviewer repeated the funnel line, which was already out, and the growth ask got no actual answer.

faults.quote: What would you have the client do first?
faults.why: The candidate had already said what to do first: get actual rebate quotes from the major plans before committing (t25) and not decide before those payer quotes are in (t27). The follow-up re-asks an answer already given.
